report.summary: Checkout-service memory usage spiked due to Java heap exhaustion, likely caused by a memory leak or insufficient heap size, as indicated by rising resident memory and OutOfMemoryError logs.

likely_causes.title: Java heap exhaustion due to memory leak or high load
likely_causes.rationale: Logs show GC overhead limit approaching and repeated OutOfMemoryError, while metrics confirm a 1.7x increase in resident memory, indicating the heap is being exhausted.

supporting_evidence.detail: WARN checkout-service: GC overhead limit approaching; heap usage 92%
ERROR checkout-service: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space

likely_causes.title: Insufficient heap size configuration
likely_causes.rationale: The OutOfMemoryError directly indicates the configured heap is too small for the workload.

supporting_evidence.detail: ERROR checkout-service: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space

likely_causes.title: Increased traffic load causing higher memory usage
likely_causes.rationale: A 1.7x increase in resident memory could be due to higher request volume or larger payloads.

next_steps: Increase the JVM heap size and restart the service
Profile the application to identify memory leaks or large object retention
Implement stricter memory usage alerts and thresholds
Review recent code or configuration changes that may have increased memory demand

detail: Java heap exhaustion due to memory leak or high load
